naming_history: Canonical field 4 is Action from v1.6.0. The codes and downstream semantics are unchanged. The field-4 name is frozen under NAM-001 and the rule-ID permanence policy.

entries.name: Hold
entries.registry_note: HL was also used as a State code in v1.3.1. The State HL entry was a namespace collision and was removed from states.json in v1.5. Action HL remains canonical.

entries.name: Trigger
entries.description: Trigger a downstream conditional action. TR triggers a specified downstream workflow with an explicit action_target envelope, object, and authorizing event (TRG-001, draft); TR is never a generic Proceed and never itself proof of transfer.

entries.name: Closed
entries.description: Lifecycle closed; no further actions permitted. v1.6: Action CL and Class 6 (CLOSE) are bidirectionally bound — Class 6 requires CL (SEM-005) and CL requires Class 6 (SEM-020); mismatches are rejected.

entries.name: Review Warranted
entries.description: Event requires manual or enhanced review before downstream action proceeds. Mandatory output for LEG-origin events at Confidence E (LEG-004). Permitted for all Classes.
